description: This file is a Kotlin source file that implements motion activity and pedometer data handling for an Android application. It includes data classes for requests and records, a data source interface with a system implementation, and a MotionHandler class for processing motion-related requests, performing sensor data collection, classification, and permission checks.

classes.name: MotionActivityRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request for motion activity data with optional start and end ISO timestamps and a limit.

classes.name: MotionPedometerRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request for pedometer data with optional start and end ISO timestamps.

classes.name: MotionActivityRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a recorded motion activity with start and end timestamps, confidence level, and activity flags.

classes.name: PedometerRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a pedometer record, including steps, distance, and floors data.

classes.name: MotionDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for motion activity and pedometer availability, permissions, and data retrieval.

classes.name: SystemMotionDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing MotionDataSource using Android sensors to access motion data and classify activity types.

classes.name: MotionHandler
classes.description: Main class managing motion activity and pedometer requests, performing permission checks, sensor data collection, classification, and response formation.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity
methods.description: Handles motion activity requests, checks permissions, performs activity detection, and returns a JSON response or error.

methods.name: handleMotionPedometer
methods.description: Handles pedometer requests, checks permissions, retrieves step data, and returns a JSON response or error.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if system motion data sources are available.

methods.name: isActivityAvailable
methods.description: Checks if activity sensors are available.

methods.name: isPedometerAvailable
methods.description: Checks if pedometer sensors are available.

methods.name: parseActivityRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters to create a MotionActivityRequest object.

methods.name: parsePedometerRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters to create a MotionPedometerRequest object.
